file_split.method: stratified by generated category; fixed seed

simpy_evaluation.warmup_policy: All pre-cutoff events warm the workload history; pre-cutoff accesses, storage cost, and migrations are excluded from metrics.

evaluation_note: Synthetic pipeline benchmark only. The generator assigns access patterns independently of document content, so semantics is not designed to predict future demand. The unseen-file score uses IDs excluded from model fitting; the known-file score evaluates a later period for training identities.

cutoff_examples.leakage_note: Features use cutoff-time metadata/workload; TF-IDF is fit on train-file documents only, and unavailable later text is replaced with an empty representation. Retrieval uses shared explicit access_groups and past-only neighbor events. Future labels are stored separately under targets.

retrieval.permission_rule: shared explicit metadata.access_groups; missing groups means no neighbors
retrieval.content_rule: candidate created_at and modified_at must be at or before cutoff
retrieval.access_rule: neighbor access statistics include events strictly before cutoff only
